legacy-cyan.usage: Simulator canvases only — do not extend.

display.purpose: Tool page titles only — never inside cards or buttons.

label.purpose: Every form label site-wide. Uppercase, tracked.

shadows.name: glass-drop
shadows.purpose: The only drop-shadow in the system. Glass panels lifting off the void.

motion.name: ease-sf-inout
motion.purpose: Symmetric in-out for elements that need to settle.

motion.name: ease-sf-snap
motion.purpose: Sharp snap for instrument-like state changes.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Mobile floor — most tool sidebars hide here.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Tablet landscape — WorldLayout sidebar auto-collapses below this.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The lit indicator on the bridge — Beacon Teal CTA. Used for the primary action only.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: hsl(157 80% 42%); color: #fff; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(61, 255, 205, 0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(157 100% 62%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Quiet stroke over Panel Navy. Border-shift on focus is the affordance.
components.css: .ds-input-text { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8); font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 2px; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-input-text::placeholder { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); } .ds-input-text:focus { outline: none; border-color: hsl(157 80% 42% / 0.35); box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(61, 255, 205, 0.08); } .ds-input-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(157 100% 62%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: The canonical container. Sharp zero-radius corners, blurred over the void, with an optional light-arc at the bottom edge.
components.css: .ds-glass-panel { position: relative; background: rgba(14, 19, 32, 0.9); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border-radius: 0; backdrop-filter: blur(16px); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); padding: 24px; } .ds-glass-panel::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 10%; right: 10%; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, rgba(61, 255, 205, 0.25), transparent); pointer-events: none; } .ds-glass-panel-content { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; color: #C8C8C8; }

components.name: Glow Badge (Teal)
components.description: The 0.06 / 0.15 / 1.0 stack incarnated. Used for status, count, category tags.
components.css: .ds-badge-glow-teal { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: rgba(21, 193, 123, 0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(21, 193, 123, 0.15); color: hsl(157 80% 42%); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.18em; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Nav Item (Active)
components.description: Instrument-style nav: 2px Phosphor Glow left border, mono numeric prefix in Velocity Amber, Jura uppercase label.
components.html: 02PLANETARY PROFILE
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; border-left: 2px solid transparent; font-family: 'Jura', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 1.2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #C8C8C8; } .ds-nav-item.active { border-left-color: hsl(157 100% 62%); color: hsl(157 100% 62%); background: rgba(21, 193, 123, 0.06); } .ds-nav-num { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 9px; color: rgba(255, 179, 71, 0.4); } .ds-nav-item.active .ds-nav-num { color: rgba(255, 179, 71, 0.8); }

narrative.northStar: The Bridge of a Slow Ship
narrative.overview:
StellarForge looks like the cockpit of a science vessel that has time. Not the panicked flicker of a NASA-cosplay launch sequence, not the chrome-and-orange of a Hollywood spaceship — the lit ring of a deep-space observatory at hour 38 of a 200-day transit, where the navigator has the room dim, the coffee cold, and is patiently making the next reading. Linear's discipline meets Are.na's curatorial slowness. Every element earns its brightness; nothing strobes.

The system rejects four specific moods carried verbatim from PRODUCT.md: generic AI-tool SaaS gradients and glassmorphic hero cards; friendly writing-platform pastels and encouragement copy; NASA-cosplay neon-green CRT-terminal mimicry; empty Notion-clone soft-grey neutering. What's left is a quiet space-navy interface lit by a single teal beacon, with monospace numerals where data lives, sharp zero-radius edges throughout, and a 5-tier text hierarchy that refuses to put labels at the same brightness as titles.
keyCharacteristics: Three-tier surface depth (deep void → panel navy → surface lift), no shadows, no blur-as-default.
Single primary accent (Beacon Teal) carries CTAs, focus, and active state. Secondary accents each have one job.
Sharp edges. Zero radius on panels, 4px max on cards, 3px on badges, 2px on inputs.
Four typefaces, four jobs: MD Nichrome H1 only, Jura sectional, DM Sans body and buttons, JetBrains Mono data and labels.
Light arcs over shadows: depth signaled by a 1px gradient line at panel edges, not a drop shadow.
Restrained motion: 120–280ms state changes, exponential ease-out, no bounce, no choreographed entrances.

rules.name: The 0.06 / 0.15 / 1.0 Glow Rule
rules.body: Interactive accent elements stack: background hsl(accent / 0.06), border hsl(accent / 0.15), text hsl(accent). Glow is Phosphor Glow at 0.2 alpha in box-shadow only. Solid 1.0 fills are reserved for the primary CTA and the destructive button.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Beacon Teal is used on ≤10% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point. If the page reads as 'teal-themed,' the rule has been broken.

rules.name: The No Pure-Black Rule
rules.body: #000 and #fff are forbidden. Every neutral tints toward navy. The cool drift is the texture of the system.

rules.name: The Nichrome H1-Only Rule
rules.body: MD Nichrome appears as H1 and the marketing hero. Nowhere else. Buttons, cards, body, badges — all DM Sans.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: 300 (light) and 500 (medium) only. Bold (700) is forbidden. Hierarchy lives in scale and tracking, not weight saturation.

rules.name: The Tier Discipline Rule
rules.body: Never put labels, units, and descriptions at the same brightness. Tier-1 (#FAFAFA) is reserved for titles and results.

rules.name: The Light-Arc Rule
rules.body: Edges of important panels carry a 1px Phosphor Glow gradient line, not a shadow. This is the system's signature elevation cue.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No drop-shadows under cards. Surfaces are flat at rest. Glow appears only as a response to state.

rules.name: The Glassmorphism Tax
rules.body: Backdrop-blur is permitted only on glass panels that float over the void. Decorative blur on non-floating cards is forbidden.

dos: Do use the 5-tier text hierarchy on every page.
Do reserve Tier-1 (#FAFAFA) for titles and result values only.
Do use MD Nichrome for H1 page titles only.
Do put DM Sans on every button.
Do apply the 0.06 / 0.15 / 1.0 glow stack to all accent-colored interactive elements.
Do use light arcs at panel edges instead of drop-shadows.
Do keep panels at zero radius.
Do use weight contrast (300 vs 500) for hierarchy.
Do test every interactive element with a :focus-visible ring.
donts: Don't use MD Nichrome on buttons, badges, body text, or labels.
Don't use Phosphor Glow as a solid fill or text color.
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a colored stripe.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively on non-floating surfaces.
Don't put labels, units, descriptions, and titles at the same brightness.
Don't use SaaS purple-gradient hero cards or floating-screenshot heroes.
Don't use em dashes or double hyphens in copy.
Don't use rounded corners on GlassPanel.
